body:
Packages containing vaping products require adult signature confirmation, and this applies in every state. It can be a surprise if you have never ordered vapor products online, because most parcels are left at the door. This guide explains what the rule means, who can sign, what ID the carrier asks for, how to prepare, what happens if you miss the delivery, why the rule exists and how it connects with other parts of our service such as packaging and refunds. It follows our published [shipping policy](/shipping/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## What the rule means
In accordance with federal law, all vape mail orders require the use of Adult Signature Confirmation (21+) on delivery for packages containing e-cigarette related products. The carrier asks the recipient to sign and to show a government-issued photo identification that confirms they are 21 or older. The delivery employee compares the ID with the delivery and may record the details. A parcel is not left unattended, and it is not handed to a minor.

## What counts as acceptable ID
The carrier accepts a current, valid government-issued photo ID that shows your date of birth, such as a driver's license, a state ID card or a passport. The ID must be unexpired and legible, and it needs to show that you are at least 21. Digital copies and photos of IDs are generally not accepted, so have the physical document ready.

## Who can sign
An adult aged 21 or over. The recipient name should match the ID where the carrier requires it. If another adult at the address will receive the parcel, tell us in the order notes and check with the carrier, because some carriers require the named recipient to sign and others allow any adult at the address. If you are not sure, it is simplest to be present yourself, or to choose an address where the named person will be.

## Preparing for delivery
- **Keep a valid photo ID ready,** where you can reach it quickly.
- **Watch your tracking email** for the delivery window.
- **Be available during the likely window,** or arrange for an authorized adult to be.
- **Consider a workplace address,** if your employer allows it and someone is usually present.
- **Keep your phone on,** because the carrier may call to coordinate.
- **Make sure the address is complete,** including apartment or suite numbers.

See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/) for more on choosing an address, and [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) for how long delivery takes.

## What the delivery looks like
The delivery employee arrives, asks for the recipient, checks the ID against the age requirement and asks for a signature, often on a handheld device. The process takes a minute or two. If no adult is available to sign, the parcel is not left, and the employee records an attempt. The ID check is mandatory and not something the delivery employee can waive, even for a regular customer.

## If you miss delivery
Carriers typically leave a notice and retry, and after a limited number of attempts return the package to the sender. If the package is returned because no one was available to sign, we can issue a refund less the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost, as explained in the [shipping policy](/shipping/). That is why it matters to plan: a missed delivery can cost you more than the delay. If you see a delivery notice, contact the carrier to arrange a redelivery window as soon as you can, and let us know if you need help.

## Why this rule exists
Adult signature confirmation is part of federal and state rules for remote vape sales, designed to keep age-restricted products out of the hands of minors. It is covered in our [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) and in [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/). We apply it to every order, whatever the payment method or the size of the order, because the rule applies to the product.

## Packaging
Parcels are shipped in standard packaging without product names or logos on the outside, but packages carry the labels required by law. See [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/) for details. The label does not change the signature requirement.

## Common situations
### I live in an apartment building
Give the complete address including the unit number, and tell the carrier how to reach you, such as a buzzer code. If a front desk accepts packages, check whether they can sign for adult-signature parcels, because many cannot.

### I work from several places
Choose the address where an adult is most likely to be present during the day, and let us know in the order notes if there is a specific contact.

### Someone else will receive it
Tell us in the order notes and check with the carrier. The person needs to be 21 or older and show ID.

### The name on my ID is different
Use a name that matches your ID for the order, or tell us in the notes. A mismatch can cause the carrier to refuse delivery.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I request a different delivery option?
Adult signature is required, so there is no option to leave the parcel unattended. You can arrange the best time and place through the carrier's tracking page.

### Does the rule apply to wholesale orders?
Yes. Adult signature applies to every shipment of vapor products.

### What if the carrier says my ID is not valid?
Ask which part is a problem. If it is expired or illegible, you will need a valid ID to receive the parcel, and we can help if redelivery is needed.

### Will you ever ask me to send a photo of my ID?
We confirm age through the age gate and checkout. If we ever need further verification, we will explain why and how, and we will never ask for it in an unexpected message. See our [privacy policy](/privacy/).

## Related reading
Read [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/). Ask questions through the [contact page](/contact/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Making delivery easy
### Talk to the carrier early
When your tracking email arrives, open the carrier's tracking page and look for delivery options. Many carriers let you pick a delivery window, request a redelivery, or hold the parcel at a facility where you can collect it with ID. These options are not always available for adult-signature parcels, but when they are, they remove most of the stress. If you cannot find them, call the carrier's customer service with the tracking number.

### Think about timing
Delivery windows are often during working hours. If you work away from home, consider a workplace address, ask a trusted adult at home to be present or take a short break at the expected time. If you live in a building with a front desk, ask whether staff can sign for adult-signature parcels, because many cannot, and the carrier may need to return when you are present.

### Be courteous
Delivery employees are following federal rules and cannot make exceptions. A polite, prepared recipient with ID in hand makes the process quick for everyone. If you cannot be there, tell the carrier rather than leaving it to chance, because repeated failed attempts end in a returned parcel and a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and shipping cost.

### Keep the products out of reach afterward
Once you have signed for the parcel, store the contents away from children and pets, as explained in [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/). Responsible storage is part of using age-restricted products. Recycle the packaging, and keep the invoice until you are sure you will keep every item.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**Does the carrier keep a copy of my ID?** Carriers check the ID and may record details such as the type and the last digits of the number, according to their own procedures. They do not usually keep a copy of the card.

**Can I sign for someone else's parcel?** Only if you are 21 or older and the carrier's rules allow it. If the parcel is addressed to another person, check the rules for that delivery before you assume you can sign.

**What if I look younger than I am?** The carrier will ask for ID, and that is exactly what it is for. Keep your ID ready, and the process is quick.

**Is there anything I can do before delivery day?** Check your tracking, confirm the address and phone number, tell anyone else at the address what to expect and make sure your ID is easy to find.

### A note on regional carriers
Because we use regional carriers, the delivery employee and the process can differ a little from what you may be used to with a national courier. The rule is the same everywhere: an adult 21 or older must sign and show government photo ID. If you are unsure how your local carrier handles a delivery, check the carrier's own help pages or call them with your tracking number before the day, and tell us if anything about the delivery arrangement concerns you so that we can pass it on.

### After the signature
Once you have signed, the parcel is yours. Check the contents against the invoice straight away and photograph anything that looks wrong before you discard the packaging, as explained in [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).
